name: Assets
description: Centralized content store for all artifacts with rich rendering, search, task linking, manual upload, and clipboard paste

apiRoutes.summary: Update text content of an editable asset

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_audit
execTools.summary: Audit asset health: check for missing thumbnails, invalid sidecars, orphaned files
execTools.description: Audit asset health: check for missing thumbnails, invalid sidecars, orphaned files. Set fix=true to auto-generate missing thumbnails and create stub sidecars.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_delete
execTools.summary: Soft-delete an asset (moves to trash, restorable until trash is emptied)
execTools.description: Soft-delete an asset (moves to trash, restorable until trash is emptied).

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_empty_trash
execTools.summary: Permanently delete all items from trash
execTools.description: Permanently delete all items from trash. This cannot be undone.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_get
execTools.summary: Retrieve a single asset's sidecar metadata by canonical filename
execTools.description: Retrieve a single asset's sidecar metadata by canonical filename.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_open
execTools.summary: Open an attached asset by canonical filename
execTools.description: Open an attached asset by canonical filename. Returns sidecar metadata plus extracted text for text-like assets; non-extractable assets return metadata-only status.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_link
execTools.summary: Link an asset to a different task, or unlink it (set taskId to null)
execTools.description: Link an asset to a different task, or unlink it (set taskId to null). Sidecar-only edit — no file move.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_list
execTools.summary: List assets with optional type filter
execTools.description: List assets with optional type filter. Returns asset count, canonical filenames, and metadata.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_list_trash
execTools.summary: List trashed assets with name, size, deleted timestamp, and days remaining before auto-purge
execTools.description: List trashed assets with name, size, deleted timestamp, and days remaining before auto-purge.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_permanent_delete
execTools.summary: Permanently delete a specific trashed asset
execTools.description: Permanently delete a specific trashed asset. This cannot be undone.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_restore
execTools.summary: Restore a trashed asset back to its original location
execTools.description: Restore a trashed asset back to its original location. Use bakin_exec_assets_list_trash first to get the filename.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_retype
execTools.description: Change an asset's type classification. Sidecar-only edit — no file move.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_save
execTools.summary: Save an agent-created file to the assets directory with standardized naming (YYYYMMDD-slug
execTools.description: Save an agent-created file to the assets directory with standardized naming (YYYYMMDD-slug.ext) and sidecar metadata. Handles directory creation, naming conventions, and .meta.json automatically.

execTools.name: bakin_exec_assets_update_content
execTools.summary: Update the text content of an editable asset
execTools.description: Update the text content of an editable asset. Only works for text-based MIME types (markdown, plain text, YAML, JSON, CSV, XML). Rewrites the entire file.
